classification: Descriptive cache/timing audit of completed C9 development workflows; not a new inference trial
interpretation: Both runs report about96% token-weighted cached input. Vibe has lower median per-request latency but more completed requests and greater total coding time. The measurements do not support treating a general cache failure as the primary explanation for these runs.
limits: Cumulative prompt counts repeatedly include shared history; they are not unique tokens or a multi-million-token context window. Request durations exclude tool execution. Different model/template/sampler and evolving trajectories prevent precision-only or architecture-only causal attribution.
